description: Hickory Dickory Dock (br05) models: a toy grandfather clock with a swinging pendulum behind a glass window and a round brass bezel where a `clock` object sits as its face. Same format as ../models.json. Props face +z and stand on y = 0.

grandfather_clock.description: A tall toy grandfather clock in warm wood with dark trim and brass, facing +z: 1 m wide at the crown, 0.6 m deep, 2.56 m tall at size 1, origin at the middle of its base. A trunk with a glass window (opening x -0.24..0.24, y 0.6..1.4) shows a brass pendulum (named part `pendulum`, pivot at y 1.52) that swings gently on its own; wiggle it for an extra swing. The hood carries a round brass bezel 0.74 m across centred at [0, 2.0, 0.3]: put a `clock` object (size 0.62, parent this clock) at [0, 1.668, 0.33] as its face, so its hour hand turns to point at the hour. The flat top (y 2.47, 1 m by 0.66 m) has room for a small animal to stand on; a climber can run up its sides (trunk side x = ±0.375, hood side x = ±0.45).
